_readme: Endnotes of Kenneth Howery's 2025 public financial disclosure (OGE Form 278e, nominee report) that list the underlying holdings of The Founders Fund, LP and of the Principals funds of Funds II, III and IV (the main funds hold the same positions, per the endnotes). Pages 27 to 29 only; no personal asset values are kept. Used on Erik's ruling of 2026-10-07 (decisions.md).
